overview_description.description:
QFIL Solutions is a  Dubai based Fin-Tech startup specialized in AI-driven Fin-Tech trading solutions. Capitalizing on over six years of machine learning, QFIL Solutions’ cutting-edge AI engines, apps, and web platforms built on proprietary technology help investors, institutions, and millennial retail traders to maximize gains while minimizing risks.

Our Reason of Existence 
Millennials - account for more than 60% of online traders, Yet 95% of their trades are lost and only 40% feel knowledgeable about investing, leading to massive losses,  with the mass majority seeking guidance and have trust for AI / Robotics with their finances.

Our Solutions 
- Trade more successfully : MAGUS AI - Ultimate Trading Compass , +80% Accurate Market Signals & Profit Indicators
https://www.magusai.co/

- Reduce risk: innovative SEQUENCE TRADING platform that amplifies wins with little risks.
https://sqtrading.co/

Both Solutions are B2C and B2B2C


Our Team 
Our core team comprises AI technology, cloud/blockchain innovators, financial and go-to-market experts – helping us combine the world of forex, stocks, credit, risk management and trading with breakthroughs in tech innovations
